style: Warm, clear, calm reading instructions. Browser fallback until voice night.
lines: Choose Dolch or Fry. Tap one or more sets, then tap Start.
Read the word out loud. Tap Next for another word. Tap Flag to save a word for later.
Read each word out loud. Tap Right or Not yet to move on. The hourglass never skips a word.
Choose how many words to practice. Tap Start when you are ready.
Read up to thirty words in one minute. Tap Right or Not yet for each word. Skip counts as Not yet.
Thirty words in one minute. Tap Start when you are ready.
Tap Practice these to read the words to try again, or tap Try again for a new session.
Tap a flagged word to read it, or tap Close to return.
